name: Progressive View Synthesis Training
aliases: collaborative RGBD inpainting and progressive inpainting-and-erasing
definition: A training strategy for Panoramic Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) from a single input panorama that progressively adds reference views to improve geometry and semantic coherence in occluded regions.
summary: Progressive View Synthesis Training is a NeRF strategy that synthesizes novel views from a single panorama by iteratively expanding reference views using collaborative RGBD inpainting to resolve occlusion artifacts.
